note: Maintained by the committee. Subcompetency codes and titles follow the harmonised Milestones 2.0 used by most specialties; numbering can differ in a specialty's own document, so confirm each code against the program's current ACGME Milestones before relying on it. The descriptions are the committee's paraphrase of what each subcompetency covers, not ACGME text, and carry no level language: levels are the program director's to assign.

subcompetencies.title: Patient Safety
subcompetencies.covers: Recognising, reporting and analysing safety events and system vulnerabilities, and taking part in the response to them.

subcompetencies.title: Quality Improvement
subcompetencies.covers: Using improvement methods — aims, measures, tests of change — to improve care for a population, and understanding local improvement priorities.

subcompetencies.title: System Navigation for Patient-Centered Care
subcompetencies.covers: Coordinating care across settings and teams, including transitions of care and handing over responsibility.

subcompetencies.title: Physician Role in Health Care Systems
subcompetencies.covers: Understanding how the health system's structure, resources and incentives shape care, and working within them to sustain change.

subcompetencies.title: Evidence-Based and Informed Practice
subcompetencies.covers: Framing questions from practice, finding and appraising evidence, and using data about one's own practice or setting to guide decisions.

subcompetencies.title: Reflective Practice and Commitment to Personal Growth
subcompetencies.covers: Seeking and acting on feedback, reflecting on performance, and adjusting one's approach when a test of change does not go as predicted.
